clue.text: What may hinder current freedom fighters?

definitions.meaning: electrical ... opposes the flow of an electric current
an underground movement opposing an occupying power, as in wartime France

explanation.surface: A question asking what might stand in the way of today's liberation movements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' looks like 'present-day' qualifying the fighters, but it is the electrical current.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: the physical property opposing electrical flow, and an organised underground movement against occupiers.

clue.text: The last thing needed in our time is wrath

indicators.note: the final letter of the following word is the only part of it that is wanted

parts.note: an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A grumble that fury is the final thing this era requires.
explanation.definitionFit: Rage and wrath are synonyms for violent anger.

clue.text: Separate European city located in the 23?

parts.note: Split is a port city on the Croatian coast
the clue numbered 23 gives high peaks, and being located high in the hills is being up

explanation.surface: Asks whether a separate European city sits among the peaks of the other clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The 23 cross-refers to 23-across, whose answer is the peaks; being among them is being 'up'.
explanation.definitionFit: To split up is to separate, as a couple or a group parting ways.

clue.text: Marvellous things to read from elevated characters

parts.note: super is informal for excellent or marvellous
scripts are texts read out by actors

explanation.surface: Great reading material drawn from lofty figures in a story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters' suggests people in a story, but here they are printed symbols.
explanation.definitionFit: Small symbols printed raised above the line of text, like exponents, are these printed characters.

clue.text: Eagerness in the manner of big town needing to entertain queen

parts.note: a la, French, means in the style or manner of

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to hold them within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a city is a large town
R is short for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: Keenness, as shown by a large town eager to host the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Alacrity means brisk and cheerful readiness, a synonym for eagerness.

clue.text: Produce from island including apples primarily

indicators.note: the island word takes in the next letter, so it goes inside

parts.note: Crete is a large Greek island

indicators.note: only the first letter of the following word is used

explanation.surface: Produce, as in fruit, coming from an island that grows apples.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Produce' looks like a noun for farm goods, but it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To create something is to produce or make it.

clue.text: Dad gets right by river for fish

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Father goes fishing on the right bank of a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A parr is a young salmon at the stage before it heads to sea.

clue.text: A sort of paper in disagreement

parts.note: tissue is a thin soft kind of paper

explanation.surface: A type of paper found in a dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: Points at issue are those being argued over, so the phrase means under dispute.

clue.text: Revolution bound, they say, to be a growing tendency

parts.note: a rising is a revolt or rebellion

indicators.note: signals that what follows is a word as heard in speech

parts.note: tied means bound with rope or string

explanation.surface: A revolution is sure to become a trend, so people claim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' seems to mean 'certain', but it means tied up.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively, an increasing current of opinion or events is likened to the sea coming in.

clue.text: Good shield may be seen to be so expensively protected!

definitions.text: Good shield may be seen to be so expensively protected!

parts.words: Good shield may be seen to be so expensively protected!
parts.note: a fine shield might be covered in a thin layer of the precious yellow metal, a costly way to protect it

explanation.surface: A fine shield is guarded at great cost.
explanation.walkthrough: A visual touch: the outer letters GO and LD of 'Good shield' read as the precious metal wrapped around the rest, so the shield is literally coated.
explanation.definitionFit: Coated with a thin layer of the precious yellow metal, which is an expensive covering.

clue.text: Loss of title

definitions.meaning: a failure to hit or catch, a near thing gone wrong
the form of address for an unmarried woman

explanation.surface: Losing a title, as a deposed noble might.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a failure to hit and the honorific used before an unmarried woman's surname.

clue.text: Like an agricultural procedure that could make husband snarl

indicators.note: the letters could be made into something else, so they are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A farming method that might make a husband growl.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearing land by cutting and burning vegetation is a farming practice, and the hyphenated phrase describes it adjectivally.

clue.text: Wizard beginning but not ending

indicators.note: the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a start is a beginning

explanation.surface: A sorcerer starting out but never finishing.
explanation.definitionFit: Wizard is informal for an outstanding performer, a top performer.

clue.text: Toy boy keeps talking

parts.note: a rattle is a baby's toy
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: A young male lover who chatters endlessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Toy boy' reads as one phrase for a young lover, but it splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To go on talking at length, often tediously, is an idiomatic phrasal verb.

clue.text: Cowardly buffoon to buzz off stifling a cry of pain

indicators.note: to stifle is to smother, so the other piece is held inside

parts.note: scram means go away quickly
ouch is what one says when hurt

explanation.surface: A fool told to clear off while suppressing a yelp.
explanation.definitionFit: Scaramouch is the boastful but cowardly clown of Italian commedia dell'arte.

clue.text: Types devoid of originality organising cosy pact

indicators.note: organising means arranging, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Unoriginal people arranging a comfortable deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Imitators who slavishly follow others lack originality.

clue.text: Idiot leading part of hospital getting agreement

indicators.note: one piece goes in front, ahead of the next

parts.note: an ass is a fool
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

explanation.surface: A fool in charge of a hospital department gets consent.
explanation.definitionFit: Assent is formal consent or approval.

clue.text: Man sits in this water

parts.note: the Isle of Man lies in the stretch of sea between Britain and Ireland

explanation.surface: A man sitting in a bath or pond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, the island between Great Britain and Ireland, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea separating Great Britain from Ireland contains the Isle of Man.

clue.text: Country game with someone really good in charge

parts.note: RU is rugby union
ST stands for saint, a very good person

explanation.surface: A rural sport run by a virtuous person.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustic describes things of the countryside, as country does used as an adjective.

clue.text: Hardly any money with repose becoming most unpleasant

parts.note: a sou was an old French coin of tiny value, so a trifling sum
rest means repose

explanation.surface: Being broke while idle makes one bitterly miserable.
explanation.definitionFit: Sour means disagreeable, and the superlative gives most disagreeable.

clue.text: Broken item of furniture — succeed in holding it together

indicators.note: one piece holds the other within it

parts.note: a bed is a piece of furniture
to reach a goal is to succeed in getting there

explanation.surface: A broken piece of furniture somehow kept in one piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A wall or defence that is breached has been broken through.

clue.text: Uncongenial house with alternative to gate in the country

parts.words: alternative to gate in the country
parts.note: a stile is a set of steps for climbing over a rural fence instead of going through a gate

explanation.surface: A disagreeable rural house that has steps over the fence instead of a gate.
explanation.walkthrough: A STILE is a set of steps over a field fence or wall, common on British footpaths.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostile means unfriendly or antagonistic, the opposite of agreeable.

clue.text: Violent expression of disapproval about hundred being imprisoned

parts.note: fie is an old exclamation of disgust

indicators.note: the letter is shut inside the other piece

parts.note: re means concerning or about
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: An angry cry of protest at a hundred people being jailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Fierce means savage and aggressive, a synonym for violent.

clue.text: Varying in amounts (large amounts)

indicators.note: varying means changing, so these letters take a different order

explanation.surface: A note that quantities differ, some being big.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically, huge piles or heaps of something are described as towering peaks of it.

clue.text: Pungent root artist rejected as food

indicators.note: rejected means thrown out, so these letters are removed

parts.note: a radish is a sharp-tasting root vegetable
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter turns down a strong-tasting vegetable at dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish is a prepared item of food served at a meal.

clue.text: Passion in race

definitions.meaning: a preliminary round in a running or swimming contest

explanation.surface: Fervour shown in a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both intense emotion and a qualifying round of a race.

clue.text: Waste product with uranium? Region initially sealed off

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is cut away

parts.note: an area is a region

explanation.surface: Is nuclear waste present? The district was first cordoned off.
explanation.definitionFit: Urea is the nitrogenous compound by which mammals excrete waste in urine.

clue.text: Journalists, ultimately you will need pay increase — nag!

parts.note: the press means reporters collectively

indicators.note: only the final letter of the next word is used

parts.note: a rise is an increase in salary in British usage

explanation.surface: A demand to reporters that a wage rise is needed, plus a scolding.
explanation.definitionFit: To nag someone into something is to put pressure on them persistently.

clue.text: More than one bowler maybe in that side

indicators.note: the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Several cricket bowlers are perhaps playing for one team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bowler' suggests cricket, but it is the hard round felt hat, an example of headgear.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowler is one type of hat, so several bowlers are examples of headwear.

clue.text: Badly tainted fellows being put inside in custody

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other
done badly means botched, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: men means fellows

explanation.surface: Corrupt men are jailed and held in detention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Badly' rearranges the fodder into DETAINT, and 'being put inside' places the fellows within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being held in detention is a form of custody.
